title: justicia tenella f. crenulata
intro: Justicia tenella f. crenulata, commonly known as the "Red Chigua" or "Chinese Justicia", is a flowering plant species in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate coughs, and promote respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Justicia tenella f. crenulata include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory agent, and immunomodulator, making it a sought-after treatment for various respiratory and immune-related conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
